## 2024-03-24 - Form Field Accessibility Bindings
**Learning:** When implementing accessible form components (Input, Textarea, Select), fallback IDs generated by `useId()` should prioritize explicitly provided `id` props to prevent breaking existing Playwright or E2E tests that rely on specific IDs. For `aria-describedby`, error messages must take precedence over hint text to ensure screen readers announce validation failures first when both are present, avoiding confusing double-announcements or hint-overriding.
**Action:** Always map `<label htmlFor>` using `const elementId = props.id || useId()`, apply `aria-hidden="true"` to visual-only required asterisks, and conditionally pass `undefined` (not an empty string) to `aria-describedby` when no error or hint is present to keep the DOM clean.
